packageRules.description: SmolVM bumps auto-merge once ci.yml and the smolvm-release-verify check pass. The verify job is inert until a [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, smolvm-host] runner is registered and SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE is set — do not trust auto-merge before then.
Runner bump PR is the tripwire for the runner-watch pipeline (diff -> triage -> record-golden -> conform -> tiered PRs). Never auto-merge: the protocol delta needs the pipeline's goldens and review.

customManagers.description: Official actions/runner release pin in versions.toml. The bump PR is the tripwire: it is labeled protocol-sync, and .github/workflows/runner-sync.yml runs watch-pipeline stages on it and opens the tiered PRs (docs/conformance.md). It must never auto-merge.

SmolVM release the golden workflow builds with. The bump PR is gated by .github/workflows/smolvm-release-verify.yml, which installs the candidate and runs the real-VM E2E on the smolvm-host; green runs auto-merge.
